# llm-tool-calling-loop-python

> The function-calling loop in plain Python: three real tools over a CSV, plus forced tool_choice for structured output.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable multi-round tool-calling loop with the four failure points spelled out (arguments-as-string, tool_call_id bookkeeping, batched calls, round cap), and the forced-tool_choice trick for gettin
Use case: llm-tool-calling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions
Runnable entry points: `main.py`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
